title: Concept: Link to a service-account credential file
description: A link to a service-account or credentials JSON file in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: A service-account file carries a private key and the token URI, and anyone who downloads it can mint access tokens for everything the account can reach.
applicability: Documentation sites, build artefacts and repository browsers.
risk: A key file is a durable machine identity; it survives password resets and is rarely rotated.
